zh: 无论怎么切，整个数组的首元素和末元素都各贡献一次；每多切一刀，切口两侧的两个元素就额外各贡献一次。
总费用 = a[0]+a[n−1] 再加上所选 p−1 个切口的相邻和 a[i]+a[i+1]。切口之间互不影响，所以最小费用取最小的 p−1 个相邻和，最大费用取最大的 p−1 个。
算出 n−1 个相邻和并排序；base=a[0]+a[n−1]；最小费用 = base + 前 p−1 个之和，最大费用 = base + 后 p−1 个之和；p=1 时两者都是 base（n=1 时 base 正好是该元素的两倍）；全程用 64 位整数。
en: However you split, the first and last elements of the whole array each contribute once; every extra cut makes the two elements on both sides of the cut contribute once more.
Total cost = a[0]+a[n-1] plus the adjacent sums a[i]+a[i+1] of the p-1 chosen cuts. Cuts do not affect each other, so the minimum uses the p-1 smallest adjacent sums and the maximum the p-1 largest.

Compute the n-1 adjacent sums and sort them; base = a[0]+a[n-1]; minimum = base + the first p-1 sums, maximum = base + the last p-1 sums; for p = 1 both equal base (for n = 1, base is exactly twice the element); use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Every split pays for the first and last elements; each cut between i and i+1 adds a[i]+a[i+1]. Choose the smallest or the largest p-1 adjacent sums.

## Proof of correctness

The first-plus-last contributions of all segments decompose into the first and last elements of the whole array plus the elements on both sides of each cut; the cuts are chosen independently and there are exactly p-1 of them. Minimizing and maximizing this independent sum picks the smallest and the largest adjacent sums respectively, and the valid split built from those cuts attains the bound.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
